name: family-button
title: Family Button
blurb: Expands from circle to panel on click, animating icon and content.
description: A Framer Motion-powered button that morphs from a compact circular toggle to a full panel, swapping Plus/X icons and revealing staggered content.
use_when: You need an interactive menu or action panel that starts compact and expands smoothly.
avoid_when: When you need immediate content visibility or when the expanded size disrupts layout.
a11y: Toggle handled via onClick; no aria-expanded or expanded/collapsed labels. Content fades in after expansion animation.
